title: Settings

gameLanguage.label: Game language
gameLanguage.hint: The words in Termo and Wend, and what the chess coach says. It does not change the interface.

sound.label: Sound
sound.hint: Short tones for moves, mistakes and solving.

vibration.label: Vibration
vibration.unsupported: This device does not support vibration.

note: These settings apply to every game. Progress, streaks and best times are stored on this device. A solved daily puzzle also goes to the ranking, under a generated name you can change on your profile. From then on the server keeps the dailies you open and close, so each one counts once on every device you use. Animations follow your system's reduced motion setting.
